notes.title: We are officially launching on PlayStation 5, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X|S on July 24th!

items.text: From day one, our goal has been to make this a cooperative adventure you can play with anyone. Players on PC, PlayStation, and Xbox will be able to team up and play together online seamlessly from launch day.

All 7 worlds now include 10 Bonus Levels each, unlocked by collecting the world's green ram.

45 new levels in total. 70 Bonus Levels across the game.
Secret Levels and Red RAM are now available in Easy difficulty.

Brave Escape is participating in Battle for the Habitats, a global games event running from Earth Day (April 22) to World Environment Day (June 5). The event spans 100+ games with a goal of raising $1 million for the Rainforest Alliance and Oceana. As part of the event, two free exclusive character skins have been added:
Cockatoo skin — inspired by Cookie, one of the event's hero animals.
Dugong skin — inspired by Dougie, one of the event's hero animals.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44658531/62c1d623ed7f07673ad608394dc39f9271f51a22.gif"]

Hey everyone, A free update is coming to Brave Escape at the end of April, and we wanted to give you a little peek at what's to come.
Five worlds are getting a restructure - levels are being reorganized, and 5 levels from each world are being moved out of the main path and into a brand new category: Bonus Levels.
Serpent's Hollow
Thunder Ridge
Moai Chambers
Glooming Depths
Glacial Falls
Each world will have 10 bonus levels unlocked by collecting the world's green ram - that's 45 new levels in total.
On the visual side, the game is getting a brand new title screen along with improvements to the lighting system across the game - and many others.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44658531/faa599f8cf9764923eab6b6fbdddf3619bdd8551.gif"] More details soon. Thanks for playing!
Hit Start Team
We’ve received several reports of connection issues with Epic Online Services (EOS).
As a workaround we have added a new launch argument that allows you to completely disable EOS and use Steam Lobby/P2P services instead.
In order for this to work both players must be running the same application (e.g., both using the main game or both using the Friend’s Pass).
Right-click Brave Escape in your Steam Library.
Select Properties.
Under the General tab, find Launch Options.
Paste the following command: -noepic
We plan to add in-game options to let you choose between Steam and EOS in a future update.

We’re excited to announce a new feature for Brave Escape - Casual Mode! Does your friend have trouble with platforming (or maybe you’re that friend)? This new mode is designed to make your adventure a bit smoother.
Added Casual difficulty, a more approachable experience with fewer spikes and more forgiving timing, ideal for players less experienced with precision platformers.
You can swap between Casual and Standard difficulty at any time.
Secret levels are only accessible when playing the level on Standard difficulty.
